item.title: security: What exploited vulnerabilities have in common: A data-driven analysis of real-world attacks
item.description:
Microsoft Security Blog says real-world exploitation is concentrated in a small subset of CVEs, and defenders should prioritize vulnerabilities by exploitation likelihood, exposure, and potential blast radius. The post presents a data-driven analysis of exploited vulnerabilities.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
